correctness.rationale: The beta-moment normalization gives w_m=24/[m(m+1)(m+2)(m+3)]. Absolute summability of m^2 w_m justifies the Hessian. Grouping real conjugate Fourier modes gives eigenvalues N(A_k+A_{N-k}-2A_0). The two displayed exact rational differences of a_m prove positivity and the central minimizers for all N. Uniform inverse-power expansions of residue sums and symmetric Hurwitz-zeta values prove both asymptotic coefficients; direct perturbation checks agree.

value.rationale: Quantifies the Hessian of a classical minimizer beyond the range of pairwise convexity, with a mathematically structural inversion of least-curved Fourier mode from first to central and sharp leading order N^-1 instead of N. The precise two-term curvature law determines local conditioning for all pole counts and is not a restatement of global optimality.
